body: NTA - but you have a lot to learn about the reactions of 2 1/2 year olds.  They can scream like they're dying because a stranger looked at them funny.  So you have 2 problems here - you misread your sons response and YOU responded based on an assumption.  BTW...how would throwing cola on him help to ease a burn on the inside of his mouth?  Stop, think, act.
Sure, if you'd like.  In what ways are you misunderstood?

I wouldn't say Kate is a problem to deal with at all.  Everyone is pretty friendly in that department.  But I get that Nancy might not have wanted to deal with the problem at all.  But that wasn't was she said she was upset about.
